result.title: BreastXAgent: A lightweight agentic explainability framework for breast density classification
result.comment: 8 pages, 2 figures. Published in Proceedings of SPIE, Vol. 14346, Third International Conference on Frontiers of Applied Optics and Computer Engineering (AOCE 2026)
result.summary: Deep learning models for breast density classification typically return only a label and confidence score. This paper presents BreastXAgent, a lightweight agentic framework that combines a pretrained classifier, Grad-CAM visual explanation, LangGraph-based routing, LLM report generation, and rule-based guardrails to produce controlled, faithful, non-diagnostic reports. On 160 mammography images, uncontrolled LLM reporting produced 75% Grad-CAM overclaims and 62.5% clinical overclaims. Strict prompting and LangGraph routing improved safety but did not eliminate violations. The full BreastXAgent achieved 100% safety pass rate, zero overclaims, and highest utility score. Results demonstrate that agentic guardrails enable safe, structured explanation generation without modifying the underlying classifier.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 BreastXAgent，一个结合预训练分类器、Grad-CAM 解释、LangGraph 路由、LLM 报告生成与规则护栏的轻量 agent 框架，用于乳腺密度分类的非诊断性报告生成，并评估其过度断言与安全性。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作聚焦临床报告生成的安全护栏与外部解释，不改动模型内部状态，也不涉及视觉推理中的 latent 状态、证据筛选或停止决策，缺少与 LVR 研究的实质联系。
